function.arguments:
{"command":"bash -lc 'python3 - <<"PY"
from pathlib import Path
p=Path("/tmp/md4c_trace.c")
s=Path("/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/src/md4c.c").read_text()
needle="static int\nmd_is_link_title(MD_CTX* ctx, const MD_LINE* lines, MD_SIZE n_lines, OFF beg,\n                 OFF* p_end, MD_SIZE* p_beg_line_index, MD_SIZE* p_end_line_index,\n                 OFF* p_contents_beg, OFF* p_contents_end)\n{\n    OFF off = beg;"
rep="static int\nmd_is_link_title(MD_CTX* ctx, const MD_LINE* lines, MD_SIZE n_lines, OFF beg,\n                 OFF* p_end, MD_SIZE* p_beg_line_index, MD_SIZE* p_end_line_index,\n                 OFF* p_contents_beg, OFF* p_contents_end)\n{\n    fprintf(stderr, \"CALL title beg=%u n_lines=%u size=%u\\\\n\", (unsigned)beg, (unsigned)n_lines, (unsigned)ctx->size);\n    for(MD_SIZE di=0; di<n_lines && di<5; di++) fprintf(stderr, \" line[%u]=%u..%u\\\\n\", (unsigned)di, (unsigned)lines[di].beg, (unsigned)lines[di].end);\n    OFF off = beg;"
assert needle in s
s=s.replace(needle, rep, 1)
s=s.replace("    /* First char determines how to detect end of it. */\n    switch(CH(off)) {", "    /* First char determines how to detect end of it. */\n    fprintf(stderr, \" before switch off=%u line_index=%u end=%u ch=%d\\\\n\", (unsigned)off, (unsigned)line_index, (unsigned)lines[line_index].end, off<ctx->size?(int)CH(off):-1);\n    switch(CH(off)) {", 1)
s=s.replace("        line_index++;\n    }\n\n    return FALSE;", "        fprintf(stderr, \" finished line_index=%u off=%u line_end=%u nextbeg=%u\\\\n\", (unsigned)line_index, (unsigned)off, (unsigned)line_end, line_index+1<n_lines?(unsigned)lines[line_index+1].beg:999999u);\n        line_index++;\n    }\n\n    return FALSE;", 1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
sed -n "2101,2165p" /tmp/md4c_trace.c | head -80
gcc -fsanitize=address -g -O0 -I/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/src /tmp/fuzzmain.c /tmp/md4c_trace.c /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/src/md4c-html.c /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/src/entity.c -o /tmp/fuzz_trace'"}
